easyPrerequisites:
An opponent controls a permanent that shares a card type with the one you intend to donate.
Lure attached to Sentinel.
Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Shifting Loyalties by paying {5}{U}, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Ruric Thar.
During your next declare attackers step, declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Ruric Thar to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Ruric Thar.
Ruric Thar triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
